stem: Which Gross type of oesophageal atresia has a distal tracheo-oesophageal fistula?
explanation: Gross C is the classic and most common form of oesophageal atresia, with a proximal blind pouch and a distal tracheo-oesophageal fistula.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because Gross A is pure oesophageal atresia without a fistula.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Gross B has a proximal tracheo-oesophageal fistula rather than a distal fistula.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because Gross C is the classic and most common form of oesophageal atresia, with a proximal blind pouch and a distal tracheo-oesophageal fistula.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because Gross E is an H-type tracheo-oesophageal fistula without oesophageal atresia.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because Gross D is pure tracheo-oesophageal fistula without oesophageal atresia.

source.hint: Identify the type that represents the most common clinical presentation of this anomaly.
